channel.title: AI News — A Guide to Cloud & AI
channel.description: Daily AI news digest — curated headlines, summaries and trends

item.title: Supercharge your AI agents: The New ADK Integrations Ecosystem
item.description: The Agent Development Kit (ADK) now features a variety of third-party integrations, allowing developers to connect AI agents with tools like GitHub and Notion. This enhances the capability of AI applications in real-world scenarios.

item.title: How we built the Google I/O 2026 Save the Date experience
item.description: Google I/O 2026 is set for May 19-20, featuring a save the date puzzle that showcases AI's potential. The event aims to engage attendees with innovative experiences leading up to the keynotes.

item.title: You can't stream the energy: A developer's guide to Google Cloud Next '26 in Vegas
item.description: Google Cloud Next '26 in Las Vegas emphasizes in-person networking and hands-on learning about agentic AI. The event will cover various technical topics, providing developers with essential tools for modern challenges.

item.title: What's new in TensorFlow 2.21
item.description: Google has launched LiteRT, the successor to TFLite, enhancing GPU and NPU acceleration for AI applications. This update also includes support for PyTorch and JAX, marking a significant shift in TensorFlow's deployment capabilities.

item.title: Introducing Wednesday Build Hour
item.description: Google Cloud's Wednesday Build Hour offers developers hands-on sessions to improve their cloud skills, focusing on AI agents and productivity tools. This initiative aims to foster practical learning and immediate application.

item.title: Unleash Your Development Superpowers: Refining the Core Coding Experience
item.description: The Gemini Code Assist team has rolled out updates to enhance coding workflows, introducing features like Agent Mode and Inline Diff Views. These tools aim to make AI a more effective coding partner.

item.title: Introducing Finish Changes and Outlines, now available in Gemini Code Assist extensions on IntelliJ and VS Code
item.description: New features in Gemini Code Assist for IntelliJ and VS Code include Finish Changes and Outlines, which streamline coding by reducing manual inputs and improving code comprehension. These tools aim to enhance the coding experience.

item.title: Here's my favorite email trick for cleaning up inbox clutter - automatically
item.description: An email trick to automatically clean up inbox clutter is highlighted, showcasing a built-in feature in most email solutions. This aims to help users manage their emails more efficiently.

item.title: Apple update looks like Czech mate for locked-out iPhone user
item.description: A university student faces issues accessing their iPhone due to a removed character from Apple's Czech keyboard, preventing them from entering their passcode. This highlights potential accessibility problems with tech updates.

item.title: After using Lenovo's new Yoga laptop, I'm wondering if Windows makers are running out of ideas
item.description: Lenovo's Yoga 7a 2-in-1 laptop is reviewed as versatile but struggles with mid-tier hardware that may not compete well against rivals. This raises questions about innovation in Windows laptops.

item.title: The $30 Google TV stick may be the budget Chromecast successor we've been waiting for
item.description: Walmart is set to release a $30 Google TV stick, which could serve as an affordable successor to Chromecast, appealing to budget-conscious consumers.

item.title: Sam Altman responds to ‘incendiary’ New Yorker article after attack on his home
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed a recent attack on his home and responded to a critical New Yorker article questioning his credibility.

item.title: How Salesforce and ServiceNow are squaring off in the battle for the helpdesk
item.description: Salesforce and ServiceNow are competing for dominance in the helpdesk market, with each company adopting different strategies to engage users and govern AI agents.

item.title: I stopped guessing which AA batteries are dead - this charging station keeps them in check for me
item.description: The Olight Ostation 2 Pro battery charger helps users easily identify dead AA batteries, enhancing convenience for flashlight enthusiasts.

item.title: Two different attackers poisoned popular open source tools - and showed us the future of supply chain compromise
item.description: Recent supply chain attacks have compromised popular open source tools, highlighting vulnerabilities that could affect thousands of organizations.

item.title: Your article about AI doesn’t need AI art
item.description: A critique of the AI-generated illustration accompanying the New Yorker profile of Sam Altman raises concerns about the portrayal of AI figures.

item.title: Your Push Notifications Aren’t Safe From the FBI
item.description: The FBI's ability to access push notifications raises concerns about privacy and surveillance, amid other significant news like Iran's internet blackout.

item.title: My baby deer plushie told me that Mitski’s dad was a CIA operative
item.description: A lighthearted exploration of a rumor about Mitski's father being a CIA operative showcases the bizarre nature of internet gossip.

item.title: How the Internet Broke Everyone’s Bullshit Detectors
item.description: The internet's evolution has outpaced our ability to discern truth, with AI-generated content and restricted data complicating verification.

item.title: tensor-optix 1.2.3
item.description: The tensor-optix 1.2.3 update introduces an autonomous training loop for sequential learning models, enhancing capabilities for TensorFlow and PyTorch users.

item.title: What is US stock market prediction for Monday, and will Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq stay in red or turn green? Wall Street prediction and US stocks to watch
item.description: Wall Street predictions for the US stock market show mixed signals as inflation data and geopolitical tensions impact the Dow Jones, S&P 500, and Nasdaq. Analysts are closely watching these trends to gauge market direction.

item.title: How to build UX using GPT-5.2 + MUI – Use UXPin Merge!
item.description: The article discusses how to build user experiences using GPT-5.2 and MUI, enabling the creation of production-ready React UIs with UXPin Merge for synchronized design systems. This approach streamlines the design and development process.

item.title: o2-cli added to PyPI
item.description: The O2 CLI has been added to the Python Package Index (PyPI), providing a command-line interface for the O2 decentralized exchange trading platform. This addition aims to enhance user interaction with the platform.

item.title: The best AR and MR glasses in 2026: Expert tested and reviewed
item.description: A review of the best augmented reality (AR) and mixed reality (MR) glasses for 2026 highlights their capabilities in blending digital content with the physical world for enhanced work and entertainment experiences.

item.title: Maine could be the first state to ban new data centers. These 11 other states tried and failed.
item.description: Maine is considering a moratorium on new AI data centers until 2027, becoming the first state to propose such a ban. This follows failed attempts by 11 other states to regulate AI infrastructure growth.

item.title: How Iran out-shitposted the White House
item.description: The article discusses how Iranian state media effectively countered the White House's online messaging during early conflicts, showcasing a stark contrast in communication strategies amid the war.

item.title: How AI is getting better at finding security holes
item.description: Anthropic announced that its new AI model successfully identified security flaws in all major operating systems and web browsers, indicating significant advancements in AI's ability to detect vulnerabilities.

item.title: OpenAI’s TBPN deal shows how talent, media, and influence are collapsing into one
item.description: OpenAI's recent TBPN deal illustrates the merging of talent, media, and influence, reflecting a broader trend in the industry where these elements are increasingly interconnected.

item.title: Miliband blamed as OpenAI pulls out of £31bn investment plans over high energy costs in huge blow to Labour’s bid to make Britain an ‘AI superpower’
item.description: OpenAI has paused its £31 billion investment plans in the UK due to high energy costs and regulatory uncertainties, impacting Labour's ambitions for Britain to become an AI superpower.

item.title: histox added to PyPI
item.description: The histox package has been added to PyPI, offering deep learning tools specifically designed for digital histology applications. This aims to enhance research capabilities in the field.

item.title: tensor-optix 1.2.2
item.description: Tensor-optix 1.2.2 introduces an autonomous training loop for sequential learning models, featuring built-in algorithms for TensorFlow and PyTorch. This enhancement simplifies the training process for developers.

item.title: coding-proxy 0.2.1a1
item.description: Coding-proxy 0.2.1a1 is a multi-vendor proxy designed for Claude Code, offering high availability and support for various AI tools. This tool enhances integration and efficiency for developers working with multiple platforms.

item.title: Hungarian government creds left in the safe hands of 'FrankLampard'
item.description: Hungary's government has discovered nearly 800 state logins in breach data, highlighting vulnerabilities in their password management. This incident raises concerns about national security and the importance of cybersecurity measures.

item.title: nng-ssl added to PyPI
item.description: NNG-SSL has been added to PyPI, providing high-performance Python bindings for nng with built-in TLS support. This addition enhances security and performance for developers using nanomsg-next-gen.

item.title: 'A billionaire's chief of staff': How this AI pioneer puts a dozen agents to work
item.description: AI pioneer Illia Polosukhin emphasizes the need for institutions to adapt as AI agents become more capable. His insights reflect the evolving landscape of AI and its implications for society.

item.title: Canva acquires Simtheory and Ortto to expand its Creative OS into AI and marketing automation
item.description: Canva's acquisition of Simtheory and Ortto aims to expand its Creative OS into AI and marketing automation, positioning it against Adobe and Salesforce. This move signifies Canva's ambition to dominate the enterprise market.

item.title: Anthropic’s Claude Mythos AI fears trigger $2 trillion wipeout in IT stocks; JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warns 'AI will likely worsen...'
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Mythos AI has caused a $2 trillion selloff in IT stocks, prompting urgent discussions among top bank CEOs. The model's potential to exploit software vulnerabilities raises significant concerns in the tech industry.

item.title: skilllint 1.7.0
item.description: Skilllint 1.7.0 is a static analysis linter for Claude Code plugins and agents, enhancing code quality and reliability. This tool aids developers in maintaining high standards in their AI projects.

item.description: Microsoft's Project Helix is testing a new hybrid gaming system that merges console and PC capabilities, featuring a revamped dashboard. This initiative aims to enhance user experience across gaming platforms.

item.title: Sam Altman recalls resisting Musk for control of OpenAI ahead of April 27 trial
item.description: Sam Altman reflects on his efforts to maintain OpenAI's independence amid tensions with Elon Musk before a trial. His actions were crucial for the organization's survival and future direction.
